name: huahin-properties
description: Dev-only tooling for Firestore emulator security tests (Conversation Ownership). Not part of the deployed site.

scripts.test:chat: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.32.1 emulators:exec --config tests/firebase.sec-test.json --project demo-sec-test-01 --only firestore "mocha tests/chat/chat-path.test.js tests/chat/chat-fallback-path.test.js --timeout 60000"
scripts.test:chat-live-gate: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.32.1 emulators:exec --config tests/firebase.chat-live.json --project demo-sec-test-01 --only firestore,auth "mocha tests/chat-live/gate.test.js --timeout 120000"
scripts.test:sec: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.32.1 emulators:exec --config tests/firebase.sec-test.json --project demo-sec-test-01 --only firestore,storage "mocha tests/sec-helpers.selftest.test.js tests/sec-gaps.rules.test.js tests/sec-gaps.storage.test.js tests/functions/create-case.characterization.test.js tests/sec-callsite-guard.test.js --timeout 60000"
